text:
Alex P: quick heads-up — ACME SI reported tokenization perf spike when we run cuda 12.2 + driver 535.3 on their marketplace image at 512 tokens. they saw latency jump ~2.3x. can we align on pinning strategy and an immediate mitigation? :eyes:
Maria O: Ugh. Do we know if it's a kernel/driver regression or a runtime/kernelset change? ACME says it started after their node image bumped the driver.
Ravi S: early triage: logs point to a kernel fallback in cuBLAS during some quantized matmul paths. not 100% yet. i started a reproducer on an a100 canary. will paste commands in a sec.
Ravi S: repro command: ```
# run minimal repro
./bench_infer --model xlm-small --seq 512 --batch 1 --cuda-version 12.2 --driver 535.3 --quant int8
```
Jen L: tagging marketplace/ops and SI comms: @Maria O we need to decide if we force-pin driver to 535.0 in marketplace images or add a runtime fallback to older kernels. forcing pins impacts customers who want newer drivers.
Maria O: agreed. Two parallel tracks: (1) short-term: pin marketplace images used by Redwood Dedicated/Private to 535.0 and push a “compat” image to the SI. (2) mid-term: add runtime kernel-selection fallback + unit smoke that catches the perf-regression class.
Kevin T: for short-term hotfix we can publish a compat image and enable rollout via our marketplace channel with canary first (5% nodes). if canary looks good, roll to 100% over 2h. we should also prepare a CVE-style advisory? even if not security, customers expect comms.
Alex P: timeline thoughts? Ravi — how long for repro + perf delta confirmation?
Ravi S: repro done on canary in ~18m, perf delta confirmed. I'm running an extended run to check memory/KV-cache behavior (30m).
Jen L: i'll draft a short comms blurb for partner/SI + marketplace release note. include mitigation steps and rollback plan. ping me when we have the confirmed perf numbers. :memo:
Maria O: on the pinning side, ops suggests we do an image tag like `redwood/runtime:compat-535-2026-03-22` and keep it available for Dedicated customers. SI gets a private tag and a migration playbook.
Kevin T: add a dashboard panel in the console for "driver stability signals" — hourly summary of p95/p99 for token latency and an automated alert if delta > 40% vs baseline. Oncall Bot can page SRE if threshold hit.
Oncall Bot: deploy pipeline: canary rollout job queued -> job id 8923. see https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/8923
Alex P: good. other asks: legal/partners for joint announcement? we should coordinate messaging with ACME SI so they can prep customer-facing notes. Jen, can you run that by Partnerships?
Jen L: will loop in Partnerships and DI on the draft. propose we call it a "compatibility advisory" not a "regression" in public text until we have root cause. keeps tone neutral.
Ravi S: next technical step: build a small nightly test that iterates driver builds + cuda combos and records perf histogram. snippet for the cron job: ```
0 * * * * /opt/redwood/tests/driver_compat_check.sh --matrix "535.0:12.2,535.3:12.2,540.0:12.3" > /var/log/driver-compat/hourly.log
```
Maria O: perfecto. ops will wire that into the stability signal dashboard Kevin mentioned. also we'll attach the marketplace image pin labels and a rollback tag.
Kevin T: after canary completes (job 8923) i'll kick the 2h staged rollout and schedule a 30-min sync at +3h to assess.
Alex P: thanks all. action items: Ravi confirm repro and attach perf numbers (ETA ~30m); Maria publish compat image + pin plan; Kevin run canary + dashboard alert; Jen draft partnership comms. we'll meet in #partnerships in 3h for post-rollout review. :thumbsup:
Maria O: noted. starting image build now.
Ravi S: perf numbers attached to the job logs (ci job 8923) — p95 18ms -> 41ms under the bad driver.
Jen L: drafting comms, will send to Partnerships for review in 45m.
Kevin T: canary started. monitoring UI link: https://console.redwood/monitoring/driver-stability?job=8923
Oncall Bot: canary job 8923 completed: status=pass (canary p95 within threshold)
Alex P: great work. we'll keep this thread for the postmortem notes and the final rollback timeline if needed.
